text: The story file 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-SVC-P1 rwb-source-data (Source data)/RWB P1 E2008 APP Payment matching with the missed payment event v1.md and the fragment _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P1-E2008-APP.json, both already written by the parallel Work Package B-P1-08 for the same slice RWB-P1-E2008-APP, stand as the deliverable of B2-P1-014: they are not rewritten, not versioned to v2 and not duplicated, their six missing values stay registered once as CG-B-P1-08-E2008-1 to -6 with ASM-B-P1-08-E2008-1 to -6, and B2-P1-014 registers only this duplicate-Work-Package finding. The story keeps its own metadata, its six new D-RCV-60 criteria, its ten legacy test case IDs with the Level column, its section 12 tables and its citation set unchanged; the two Work Packages are treated as one slice of the plan.
why: The Work Package names the story file and the fragment as its outputs, and both already exist in the tree with complete content (19 sections, 20 metadata rows, the AC origin tags, the citations resolved by the B-P1-08 registers), because the plan issues two Work Packages for one slice and both were running at the same time. Root AGENTS.md rule 1 forbids editing a file that already exists and rule 13 forbids stopping the run, so the existing artefacts are kept and the collision is recorded as a gap instead of being resolved by a second write that would overwrite a live worker's output.
read: _work/msr/wp/B-P1-08.md and _work/msr/wp/B2-P1-014.md (identical 'Write only' paths for RWB-P1-E2008-APP); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (one slice RWB-P1-E2008-APP, legacy RWB-E2-008, service rwb-source-data); _work/msr/gaps/B-P1-08.jsonl and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P1-08.jsonl (the rows the story cites); root AGENTS.md rules 1, 2 and 13
applied_in: B2-P1-014: story file and fragment left unchanged, no row duplicated; _work/msr/gaps/B2-P1-014.jsonl (1 row); _work/msr/assumptions/B2-P1-014.jsonl (1 row); _work/msr/editlog/B2-P1-014.md
confirm: Delivery lead and the stage B coordinator at the wave 2 batch close, when the plan is de-duplicated
impact: If the coordinator instead wants B2-P1-014 to own the file, the file must be rewritten from the same source and the six B-P1-08 rows re-cited, which changes every CG and ASM citation in the story and in the fragment for no change of content; if B-P1-08 is retired, its six rows must be carried forward under one set of numbers rather than re-registered.
